candidates.name: Mycosis fungoides
support_spans: Multiple erythematous and violaceous plaques and nodules clustered on the superior buttocks and intergluteal cleft bilaterally.
Dense infiltrate of atypical CD4+ small to medium-sized lymphocytes in the upper dermis
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of plaques and nodules on the buttocks, along with the histopathological findings of atypical lymphocytes, is consistent with Mycosis fungoides.

candidates.name: Cutaneous pseudolymphoma
support_spans: History of HSV-2 infection on the buttocks prior to the development of the current eruption at the same site.
Molecular analysis of the T-cell receptor gamma gene showed a weak clonal band in a polyclonal background.
candidates.why: The patient's history of HSV-2 infection and the presence of a weak clonal band in a polyclonal background may suggest a reactive lymphoid proliferation, such as cutaneous pseudolymphoma.
